cases.name: basic list with open and completed items
per-field last write wins; ties break on event id; a skewed write before the add loses
remove is terminal whenever it was stamped; later ops on a removed item are dropped silently
earliest create wins; ops on missing lists and items are counted as ignored
completed sorts most recent first; undo returns the item to its rank
events that do not decode are ignored; duplicate ids are kept once
archived is reversible; lists order by createdAt then id
open items with equal ranks order by id
pinned is per-field last write wins, shared by every member
a personal list takes ops from its creator only; a visibility tag that disagrees with the list is ignored
item.done alone decides done; a later item.status refines it only when it agrees on closed-ness
a status ties item.done on created_at and breaks on id; a checkbox after a status resets it; a status before the add loses
priority and description are per-field last write wins; null clears a description; unknown values are ignored
